Install a ZeekControl maintenance cron job
Enable curl support for HTTP transfers in scripts
Enable debug build with extra runtime assertions
Enable support for Maxmind's GeoIP library
Enable ipsumdump support for trace-summary
Use jemalloc allocator for improved memory performance
Enable Kerberos protocol analysis
Enable Node.js support
Build the Broker Python bindings (also required by the zeekctl, zeek-client and zkg tools)
Enable the Redis storage backend via dev-libs/hiredis
Enable Zeek and ZeekControl to send mail
Enable the bundled Spicy protocol analyzer framework
Build static libraries
Build and install the zeek-systemd-generator (for systemd init systems)
Use the tcmalloc allocator from dev-util/google-perftools
Install auxiliary command-line tools (zeek-cut, zeek-archiver, trace-summary, ...)
Install zeek-client CLI management tool
Enable ZeekControl for operating Zeek installations
Enable ZeroMQ cluster backend
Install the Zeek package manager

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Zeek is a powerful network analysis framework that is much different from the typical IDS you may know.
